label: Research pool deep dive B (24 Oct 2026)

payload.writeUp: Deep dive B of 24 October 2026: a fresh look at 21 UK companies already in the pool, re-checking from their own sites, Companies House, platform listings and the press whether each is genuinely raising now, closed, or unknown. Access status found: 4 closed, 8 contactable, 4 fundraising reported, 5 unknown. Closed raises are kept so the watch list and timeline stay honest; nothing here is presented as open without a source.
